source.title: Armagh Guardian, 8 May 1914, p. 3 ("County Council Contests"); nominations in the Portadown News, 2 May 1914, p. 5 ("Local Government Elections: Armagh County Council")
source.publisher: Armagh Guardian (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names read from the page images; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1914: polled 28 May 1914 in four divisions; the other seventeen (nineteen seats) returned unopposed. Returned unopposed. Retiring councillor; W. J. M'Kernan (N.) withdrew. The Portadown News prints "James Allen"; the Newry Reporter and the Armagh Guardian Isaac Allen.
